title: First meeting time
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the time when the F1 car first catches the safety car as 20 s.

title: Maximum separation distance
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the maximum distance between the cars before the first meeting as 225 m.

title: Second meeting time
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the total time for the second meeting after braking as 40 s.

title: Relative motion setup
description: Important Criteria: Sets up correct kinematic equations for both cars' positions to find meeting times.

title: Speed equality analysis
description: Important Criteria: Identifies that maximum separation occurs when the F1 car's speed equals the safety car's constant speed.

title: Deceleration phase analysis
description: Important Criteria: Correctly analyzes the F1 car's deceleration phase after the first meeting, including stopping time and distance.

title: Safety car motion tracking
description: Important Criteria: Maintains consistent tracking of the safety car's constant velocity motion throughout all phases.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses incorrect sign for deceleration acceleration or misapplies kinematic equations during braking phase.

title: Ignoring initial separation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Fails to account for the initial 200 m separation when setting up position equations.
